description:
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying its mana cost.
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
